implementation.targetScope: VentiMath form and recursive presentation schema language: strings, finite numbers, booleans, objects, arrays, enums/literals, unions, string-key records, lazy recursion, optional/nullable/default values, refinements and transforms. Not the entire Zod API or its internal schema protocol.

changes: Independent interpreter written from public APIs and black-box comparisons; no upstream implementation copied and no runtime dependencies.
No dynamic code generation. Cyclic and excessively deep typed input fails as validation errors; inherited properties cannot satisfy required fields.
Own data properties preserve prototype-looking record keys without prototype mutation. Schema shapes and regex state are isolated from caller mutation.
Retains legacy string-key record shorthand and required_error messages used by the app; validation and optional/default semantics otherwise target Zod 4.

caller.scope: 21 source files, 34 extracted schemas: forms and presentation documents. Private application source is read only and is not shipped. Release and application adoption remain separate.
